title: CyberDeck Route Registry
description: Machine-readable registry of control-plane routes — the single source consumed by BOTH the type/client codegen (CD-115) and the MockApiGateway/EngineGateway router (CD-127). Each route names its method, request/response/event schemas, error codes and whether it streams. The route set v1 is authored against this format in CD-114. CD-113.

schemaRef.description: a $id or relative path of a JSON Schema in shared/schemas

id.description: stable route id, e.g. projects.list — used as envelope.route

method.description: REST verb mirrored by the future real API (router maps id↔verb+path)

kind.description: unary = request/response; subscription = long-lived event stream

request.description: schema for envelope.payload on the request

response.description: schema for envelope.payload on the response (unary)

event.description: schema for each streamed event payload (subscription)

errors.description: error codes this route may return (subset of error.schema.json codes)
